level1.scope: Full upright ring pickup, top/bottom handle grip, seven-second pour and serve/release. Geometry-checked kinematic references; idealized grasps and scalar flow, not physical grip validation.

level2.scope: Two inverted nested cups, measured default layout, dry contact physics with exact simulated object feedback and estimated cup materials/leakage. No liquid mass/slosh or hardware validation; no claim for four cups, unknown height, arbitrary layouts or camera-free execution.

level3.scope: Current-model motor-feedback height probe; starts above known XY. Full service is not validated.

level3-2.scope: Motor-feedback height probe; cup count is test setup only, not a controller input. Full service is not validated.

level3-3.scope: Motor-feedback height probe; cup count is test setup only, not a controller input. Full service is not validated.

level4-0.scope: Contact-physics yaw homing and seven-second dispensing, followed by collision-checked serving with an idealized grasp. Fixed validated layout; cup starts below nozzle. Water is scalar flow, without liquid mass or sloshing. No hardware validation.

level4-286.scope: Contact-physics yaw homing and seven-second dispensing, followed by collision-checked serving with an idealized grasp. Fixed validated layout; cup starts below nozzle. Water is scalar flow, without liquid mass or sloshing. No hardware validation.

level4-180.scope: Physical homing and dispensing; collision-checked idealized-grasp serving.

level4-full.source: work/level4_yaw/full_service_prefix + recorded level4-180 homing, dispensing, and serving
level4-full.scope: Composite replay: collision-checked idealized-grasp pickup/placement followed by recorded physical homing and pouring, then idealized-grasp serving. Not one continuous contact-physics trial.

level5.scope: Experimental hybrid: prescribed-panel contact physics on a rigid compound four-cup stack; IK arm replay with sampled penetration checks. Starts with tools held. No tool grasp, docking, individual cup slip, continuous collision or full service validation.

level3-extract-2.scope: Native pickup and extraction; estimated rolled rims and aligned surrogate pads. Trial-specific force profiles; exact simulator state is used. Not a count-agnostic full service validation.

level3-extract-3.scope: Native pickup and extraction; estimated rolled rims and aligned surrogate pads. Trial-specific force profiles; exact simulator state is used. Not a count-agnostic full service validation.

level3-extract-4.scope: Four-cup pickup, horizontal presentation, internal expansion grip and separation in this fixed simulated layout. Left holds one; right holds three. Full four-cup handoff, dispensing and serving are not validated by this record. Exact simulated cup poses and estimated contact/air properties are used. No hardware validation. Replay uses the continuous screening chain; the fine-step acquisition and extraction passed separately.

level3-full.scope: Native four-cup extraction, then an IK-retargeted illustrative service continuation. Extra-cup support and grasps after the boundary are idealized; collision/contact dynamics are not validated.

level5-1.scope: Four independent rigid cups with the Level 3 shell/rim geometry and mass. Radial wall compliance and air model disabled; panels follow prescribed poses. Panel pickup and return use idealized kinematic attachments.
